Method of Attack: Malware hidden in SQL stored procedure as a database trigger that self-heals by re-inserting malicious JavaScript code into Magento store's source code
Steals user card information via JS & PHP components
Infects databases following brute-force attacks on the /rss/catalog/notifystock/ URL
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious database trigger (stored procedure) in Magento database
Malicious JavaScript code in store's header, footer, copyright section, and Magento CMS blocks
